title: Reproducing the Application Note figures
text: published -situ panels need GiottoDB DuckDB database holding cell polygons, cell centroids transcript coordinates. Application Note uses 10x Genomics Atera Situ Gene Expression, FFPE Human Breast Cancer preview dataset. two scripts repository r-package/examples/. installed package, large public input datasets bundled. Use release installed package cloned scripts. Run clone repository, r-package/ working directory: 03_dimred_concat.R needs Giotto GiottoData packages (see Giotto Suite installation instructions) downloads mini Visium object. needs local database: -situ script, point environment data run interactive R session: Neither variable needed files sit working directory default names. Optional overrides: DBLENS_TRANSCRIPT_TABLE reads transcripts table inside database instead file, DBLENS_ROI_CELL_ID centres region interest specific cell. Script 06 starts Shiny app: dragging select control re-queries transcripts inside chosen region, detail picks nested sub-region. Rscript prints widget instead launching Shiny. published panel full-window capture resulting three-view layout. Missing expression cell-type annotations shown unavailable, simulated.
code: git clone --branch v0.1.0 https://github.com/dbverse-org/dbVisuals.git setwd("path/to/dbVisuals/r-package") source("examples/03_dimred_concat.R") setwd("path/to/dbVisuals/r-package") Sys.setenv(DBLENS_DEMO_DB = "/path/to/WTA_Preview_FFPE_Breast_Cancer_xenium.duckdb") Sys.setenv(DBLENS_TRANSCRIPT_FILE = "/path/to/transcripts.parquet") source("examples/06_in_situ_zoom_overlay_transcripts_interactive.R")

title: Linked visualization examples
text: spec ordinary R list shaped like Mosaic spec, two additions: mgl_data() declares data source — either R data frame shipped Arrow IPC (type = "table"), query left DuckDB (type = "duckdb"). mgl_deckgl() declares deck.gl panel Mosaic input, participates selection Mosaic marks around . params = list(sel = list(select = "crossfilter")) creates shared selection; panels write select clause read filterBy. show several widgets one page, give tables different names: share one DuckDB-WASM instance, reused name replaces earlier table.

what: 1. Cross-filtered scatter with a marginal histogram
title: Linked visualization examples
text: deck.gl scatterplot beside Mosaic histogram. Brushing histogram filters points; interval brush writes $sel deck panel reads . getPosition = "@@=[x, y]" coordinateSystem = "@@#COORDINATE_SYSTEM.CARTESIAN" two conventions worth remembering: @@= marks JavaScript accessor expression @@# marks deck.gl constant. Cartesian want tissue coordinates — default geographic.
code: cells <- data.frame(   cell_ID    = sprintf("cell_%04d", 1:4000),   x          = rnorm(4000, 0, 40),   y          = rnorm(4000, 0, 40),   total_expr = rpois(4000, 60) )  spec1 <- mgl_spec(   meta   = list(title = "Points cross-filtered by expression"),   data   = list(cells1 = mgl_data(type = "table", df = cells)),   params = list(sel = list(select = "crossfilter")),   vconcat = list(     list(       plot = list(         list(           mark = "rectY",           data = list(from = "cells1", filterBy = "$sel"),           x    = list(bin = "total_expr"),           y    = list(count = NULL),           fill = "#60a5fa"         ),         list(           select = "intervalX", as = "$sel",           brush  = list(stroke = "currentColor", fill = "transparent")         )       ),       width = 640, height = 110, marginLeft = 40     ),     mgl_deckgl(       id        = "spatial",       filter_by = "$sel",       width     = 640, height = 420,       layers = list(list(         `@@type`         = "ScatterplotLayer",         id               = "pts",         data             = "cells1",         getPosition      = "@@=[x, y]",         getFillColor     = c(100L, 180L, 255L, 220L),         getRadius        = 2,         radiusUnits      = "pixels",         coordinateSystem = "@@#COORDINATE_SYSTEM.CARTESIAN",         positionFormat   = "XY",         pickable         = TRUE       ))     )   ) )  mosaic_gl(spec1, width = "100%", height = 560)

what: 2. Dimension-reduction pairs linked to a categorical bar
title: Linked visualization examples
text: mgl_deckgl(concat = ...) lays several panes share one layer definition, pane binding different columns x y. Toggling bar Mosaic bar chart filters every pane .
code: dimred <- data.frame(   cell_ID     = sprintf("cell_%04d", 1:2000),   leiden_clus = sample(sprintf("c%02d", 1:8), 2000, replace = TRUE),   umap_1 = rnorm(2000), umap_2 = rnorm(2000), umap_3 = rnorm(2000),   pca_1  = rnorm(2000), pca_2  = rnorm(2000), pca_3  = rnorm(2000) )  spec3 <- mgl_spec(   meta   = list(title = "UMAP / PCA pairs linked to leiden_clus"),   data   = list(dimred = mgl_data(type = "table", df = dimred)),   params = list(sel = list(select = "crossfilter")),   vconcat = list(     list(       plot = list(         list(mark = "barY", data = list(from = "dimred", filterBy = "$sel"),              x = "leiden_clus", y = list(count = NULL), fill = "#60a5fa"),         list(select = "toggleX", as = "$sel")       ),       width = 700, height = 140, marginLeft = 40     ),     mgl_deckgl(       id = "umap", filter_by = "$sel", width = 700, height = 210,       concat = list(orient = "hconcat", panes = list(         list(x = "umap_1", y = "umap_2", title = "UMAP 1 vs 2"),         list(x = "umap_1", y = "umap_3", title = "UMAP 1 vs 3"),         list(x = "umap_2", y = "umap_3", title = "UMAP 2 vs 3")       )),       layers = list(list(         `@@type` = "ScatterplotLayer", id = "p", data = "dimred",         getFillColor = c(100L, 180L, 255L, 220L),         getRadius = 3, radiusUnits = "pixels", opacity = 0.85       ))     ),     mgl_deckgl(       id = "pca", filter_by = "$sel", width = 700, height = 210,       concat = list(orient = "hconcat", panes = list(         list(x = "pca_1", y = "pca_2", title = "PC 1 vs 2"),         list(x = "pca_1", y = "pca_3", title = "PC 1 vs 3"),         list(x = "pca_2", y = "pca_3", title = "PC 2 vs 3")       )),       layers = list(list(         `@@type` = "ScatterplotLayer", id = "p", data = "dimred",         getFillColor = c(245L, 158L, 11L, 220L),         getRadius = 3, radiusUnits = "pixels", opacity = 0.85       ))     )   ) )  mosaic_gl(spec3, width = "100%", height = 620)

what: 3. Keeping data in DuckDB, and drawing polygons
title: Linked visualization examples
text: examples ship data frames browser. anything large, leave data DuckDB send query: mgl_data(type = "duckdb") con. Polygons travel GeoArrow rather JSON, drawn GeoArrowPolygonLayer. Passing con also lets widget issue follow-queries R-side DuckDB interact, instead materializing everything front. spatial / nanoarrow / geoarrow extensions already loaded connection reused.
code: # A small spatial database, so this example runs anywhere. Substitute your own # file and table names for real work. db <- file.path(tempdir(), "cells.duckdb") unlink(db) con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), db) DBI::dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial") DBI::dbExecute(con, "LOAD spatial")  DBI::dbExecute(con, "   CREATE TABLE cell_polygons AS   SELECT i AS cell_ID,          ((i - 1) %  25) * 12.0 + 6 * random() AS x,          ((i - 1) // 25) * 12.0 + 6 * random() AS y,          CAST(20 + 60 * random() AS INTEGER)   AS total_expr   FROM range(1, 501) t(i)") DBI::dbExecute(con, "ALTER TABLE cell_polygons ADD COLUMN geom GEOMETRY") DBI::dbExecute(con, "UPDATE cell_polygons SET geom = ST_Buffer(ST_Point(x, y), 4.5)")  spec4 <- mgl_spec(   meta   = list(title = "Polygons and centroids from DuckDB"),   data   = list(     cells4 = mgl_data(       type  = "duckdb",       query = "SELECT cell_ID, x, y, total_expr FROM cell_polygons"     ),     polys4 = mgl_data(       type   = "duckdb",       # The key column matters: the WKB encoder needs a key (cell_ID /       # poly_ID / id) alongside the geometry, or it falls back to plain       # Arrow and the polygon layer is silently skipped.       query  = "SELECT cell_ID, ST_AsWKB(geom) AS geometry FROM cell_polygons",       format = "geoarrow"     )   ),   params = list(sel = list(select = "crossfilter")),   vconcat = list(     list(       plot = list(         list(mark = "rectY", data = list(from = "cells4", filterBy = "$sel"),              x = list(bin = "total_expr"), y = list(count = NULL), fill = "#a78bfa"),         list(select = "intervalX", as = "$sel",              brush = list(stroke = "currentColor", fill = "transparent"))       ),       width = 640, height = 110, marginLeft = 40     ),     mgl_deckgl(       id = "insitu", filter_by = "$sel", width = 640, height = 440,       layers = list(         list(           `@@type`           = "GeoArrowPolygonLayer",           id                 = "polys",           data               = "polys4",           geometryColumn     = "geometry",           getFillColor       = c(157L, 78L, 221L, 90L),           stroked            = FALSE,           lineWidthMinPixels = 0.4,           coordinateSystem   = "@@#COORDINATE_SYSTEM.CARTESIAN",           positionFormat     = "XY"         ),         list(           `@@type`         = "ScatterplotLayer",           id               = "centroids",           data             = "cells4",           getPosition      = "@@=[x, y]",           getFillColor     = c(30L, 41L, 59L, 200L),           getRadius        = 2,           radiusUnits      = "pixels",           coordinateSystem = "@@#COORDINATE_SYSTEM.CARTESIAN",           positionFormat   = "XY"         )       )     )   ) )  mosaic_gl(spec4, con = con, width = "100%", height = 600)

title: Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget — dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget
text: spec widget specification R list, JSON string, JSON file path, existing htmlwidget. Mosaic specs rendered rMosaic; deck.gl specs rendered rDeckgl. file Output HTML file path. engine Export target. "auto" infers spec shape; "rMosaic" "rDeckgl" select R package explicitly. "mosaic" "deckgl" accepted aliases. data Optional named list data.frames register widget. data_sql Optional SQL query fetch con, db_path, project, active SQLRooms database register data_name. data_name Name used registering data_sql results. con Optional DBI connection used data_sql direct DuckDB data nodes rDeckgl spec. db_path Optional DuckDB database path used open temporary read-connection export. project Optional dbProject object DBI connection. selfcontained Passed htmlwidgets::saveWidget(). Defaults FALSE large exports can keep dependencies Arrow payloads files. data_transport Data transport passed rMosaic::mosaic() rDeckgl::deckgl(). Defaults "file" avoid base64 Arrow payloads JSON. width, height Optional widget dimensions. ... Arguments passed dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget().

title: Build a deck.gl input node for a Mosaic spec — mgl_deckgl
text: id Required identifier (used cleanup + lasso source tag). layers List deck.gl layer specs (`@type`, `data`, accessors). Layer `data` string referencing name `mgl_spec(data = ...)`. concat Optional concat config: `list(orient = "hconcat", panes = list(list(x = "umap_1", y = "umap_2"), ...))`. pane reuses `layers` position accessor swapped (pane$x, pane$y) — used UMAP / PCA dim-pair grid. filter_by Mosaic param reference (character `"$sel"`) pre-built Selection. deck.gl panel subscribes re-renders clauses change. tools Toolbar buttons. Defaults `c("pan", "lasso", "+lasso", "clear", "fit")`. `"lasso"` replaces previous lasso clause, `"+lasso"` unions new lasso previous one, `"clear"` removes deck.gl panel's lasso clause. title Optional title shown canvas. width, height CSS dimensions panel (number → px). ... options passed verbatim (e.g. `initialViewState`).

title: Render a linked Mosaic + deck.gl visualization — mosaic_gl
text: spec spec built [mgl_spec()] (plain list structure). con Optional DBI connection R-side DuckDB used hydrate `mgl_data(type = "duckdb")` references.
